user.title: Connect Nextcloud
user.description: Access to the Nextcloud in which rooms are booked. Preferably a dedicated read-only user with an app password.

calendars.title: Select calendars
calendars.description: Room bookings are read from these calendars. Delegated calendars show the owner in brackets.

error.cannot_connect: Nextcloud cannot be reached at this address.
error.no_calendars: No calendars found for this user.
error.unknown: Unexpected error, see the log for details.

abort.already_configured: This Nextcloud is already set up with this user.

init.title: Measurements and target temperatures
init.description: All fields are optional. The flow temperature comes from StokerCloud or a selected sensor; without either, the buffer reserve is estimated from valve positions only. Outside temperature and forecast come from the weather entity.

data_description.stokercloud_name: Name from the public view address. No password needed.
data_description.target_rules: One rule per line: "keyword @ room = value". The keyword is searched in the title and categories, case-insensitive. "@ room" is optional (several separated by commas). A value with a sign or K is relative to the comfort temperature, otherwise absolute, e.g. "service @ Hall = -1.5 K" or "youth = 20". The first matching rule wins. "Temperatur: 21" in the event description overrides every rule.

error.invalid_rule: Rule not readable (line {line}). Format: keyword @ room = value, e.g. service @ Hall = -1.5 K

kalibrierlauf.name: Calibration run
kalibrierlauf.description: Heats the given rooms under ideal conditions to measure buffer reserve, power demand and heating rate. Starts only after 90 minutes without heating; only on days without bookings. Other rooms are set lower meanwhile.

raeume.name: Rooms
raeume.description: Room names as in Nextcloud, e.g. Saal.

zieltemperatur.name: Target temperature
zieltemperatur.description: Default: comfort temperature of the rooms.

andere_raeume.name: Other rooms
andere_raeume.description: Setpoint of all other rooms during the run. Default: setback minus 4 K.

kalibrierlauf_abbrechen.name: Cancel calibration run
kalibrierlauf_abbrechen.description: Cancels a requested or running calibration run.

aus_historie_lernen.name: Learn from history
aus_historie_lernen.description: Discards learned room and plant values and relearns them from the recorded history (room temperatures, setpoints, valves, outside temperature; as far back as the recorder goes, usually 10 days). Results of older calibration runs are lost; safety factors from the heating log are kept.
